description:
## Why This Exists

store/overview.rs::extract_overview() uses String::from_utf8_lossy(header_bytes) to convert headers for parsing. Legacy Usenet articles with Latin-1 encoded Subject or From headers (e.g. encoded with ISO-8859-1) will have non-UTF-8 bytes replaced with U+FFFD, corrupting the stored overview subject and from fields.

The did_passthrough.rs and other modules correctly refuse non-UTF-8 input. Overview should either handle it correctly (by percent-encoding or omitting corrupted fields) or document explicitly that non-UTF-8 headers are accepted with lossy conversion.

## Acceptance Criteria

Document the lossy conversion as intentional, with a comment explaining why it is acceptable for overview display (non-security-critical, display only). OR convert to strict from_utf8 with fallback to empty string.
title: overview::extract_overview: from_utf8_lossy may corrupt header values with non-UTF-8
